title: Reception of an RRCReconfiguration by the UE

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration
entities.description: RRC message used to reconfigure UE radio parameters, received directly or via conditional reconfiguration execution.

entities.name: Conditional Reconfiguration
entities.description: Procedure where UE applies pre-configured RRCReconfiguration upon meeting certain conditions (CHO, CPA, CPC).

entities.name: SCG deactivation
entities.description: Procedure to deactivate Secondary Cell Group as specified in clause 5.3.5.13b.

entities.name: SCG activation
entities.description: Procedure to activate Secondary Cell Group as specified in clause 5.3.5.13a.

entities.name: scg-State
entities.description: IE in RRCReconfiguration indicating SCG activation or deactivation state.

entities.name: daps-SourceRelease
entities.description: IE in RRCReconfiguration triggering release of source configuration in DAPS handover.

entities.name: DAPS bearer release
entities.description: Procedure to release RLC entities and reconfigure PDCP for DAPS bearers during source release.

entities.name: SRB release for source SpCell
entities.description: Procedure to release PDCP and RLC entities for SRBs in source SpCell during DAPS handover.

entities.name: Source key discard
entities.description: Procedure to discard security keys (K_RRCenc, K_RRCint, K_UPint, K_UPenc) used in source SpCell.

entities.name: Conditional reconfiguration execution during T311
entities.description: Condition where RRCReconfiguration is applied due to conditional reconfiguration execution while timer T311 is running.

entities.name: VarConditionalReconfig clearance
entities.description: UE removes all entries in VarConditionalReconfig variable after conditional reconfiguration execution during T311.

relations.description: Conditional reconfiguration procedure involves execution of RRCReconfiguration message.
RRCReconfiguration message may contain scg-State IE.
Presence of scg-State IE triggers SCG deactivation procedure.
Presence of scg-State IE triggers SCG activation procedure.
Condition of conditional reconfiguration execution during T311 running establishes clearance of VarConditionalReconfig.
RRCReconfiguration message may contain daps-SourceRelease IE.
Presence of daps-SourceRelease IE triggers DAPS bearer release procedure.
Presence of daps-SourceRelease IE triggers SRB release procedure for source SpCell.
Presence of daps-SourceRelease IE triggers source key discard procedure.
